content: {"reasoning":"CO-197 is a missing prior-auth denial; the retro-auth window is closed, no peer-to-peer is offered, and a medical-necessity appeal has already been filed without success. There is no remaining payer avenue since the auth was genuinely missing at time of service (a provider administrative failure), so the payer will not pay. Patients cannot be billed for the provider's own authorization lapse, and billing secondary is improper when the primary denial is an auth failure. The only proper disposition is to close the balance.","action":"write_off"}
